hero.subtitle: We're two people in Park City, Kansas building the IT company we wish had existed — for the businesses Big Tech overlooks and the seniors technology left behind.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.heading: Why We Exist
mission.body: To replace expensive, fragmented SaaS stacks with AI-built custom apps, deliver White Glove IT care to the clients Big Tech ignores, and run it all from a 100% solar-powered, ADA-accessible, family-owned facility in Park City, Kansas.
mission.quote: Local, sovereign, sustainable technology is not just possible — it's better.
mission.body2: Kecktech is the IT partner that treats every client like a neighbor — whether that's an overwhelmed small business owner, a senior trying to stay safe online, or a company tired of paying $1,200 a month for tools they barely use.

cards.title: Human-First
cards.desc: Technology serves people — not the other way around. Every decision we make starts with the human on the other end, especially the ones Big Tech has historically left behind.

cards.title: Sovereign & Private
cards.desc: Your data stays in Kansas, on our servers, under your terms. We don't sell it, scan it, or profit from it — privacy is a feature, not an upsell.

cards.title: Solar & Circular
cards.desc: 100% solar-powered. Zero e-waste from our clients. Every watt from our 25kW rooftop array; every device in our HaaS fleet responsibly refurbished.

cards.title: Radically Accessible
cards.desc: ADA-first in everything: our building, our software, our process, and our team. Accessibility is in the blueprint — not bolted on after the fact.

cards.title: White Glove
cards.desc: Real humans, real accountability, real care. No offshore call centers, no ticket queues — the same people answer every time, with patience and dignity.

members.name: Jon Keck
members.title: Co-Founder & Lead Engineer
members.bio: 30+ years of enterprise IT experience. Jon built the infrastructure that powers Kecktech — from the solar array on the roof to the AI pipelines in the code. He believes the best IT support is the kind you barely notice.

facility.label: Our Facility
facility.heading: Built From the Ground Up
facility.body: Our 1,500 sq ft purpose-built data center in Park City, Kansas runs on 100% solar power — 25kW rooftop array with 100kWh battery backup. ADA-accessible. Family-owned. Your data never leaves the building.
